definition: A direct color workplace photograph that keeps a worker's precise action legible among complex machinery, using clear descriptive color and layered mechanical detail rather than a stylized cinematic grade.
lockedQualities: color describes materials and workplace context
adaptiveGuidance: Adapt viewpoint to the production task; keep hands, tools, and machine relationships readable without turning the workplace into a glossy advertisement.

sources.title: Woman working on an airplane motor at North American Aviation, Inc., plant in Calif.
supports: The Library of Congress record documents a June 1942 color transparency showing a worker performing a specific task inside complex aircraft-engine machinery.
